$comment: Ratcheted quality budgets (issue 578). Enforced by `npm run verify:budgets`.
1. CI fails when a measured value EXCEEDS its budget. Existing debt never blocks
work; only adding to it does.
2. CI also fails on UNCLAIMED SLACK - a value measurably better than its budget
without the budget being lowered. Without this the ratchet stops ratcheting and
the gate silently degrades into a no-op.
3. Every change to a value REQUIRES `finding` and `justifiedBy` to be updated.
A budget moved without a cited finding and commit is not reviewable.
Every initial value was transcribed from a committed artifact under audit/, never
typed from memory. The first transcription attempt read contaminated artifacts left
behind by the mutation harness and produced 74/16/88/1703; the harness now restores
clean artifacts and asserts no mutant marker survives. These are the clean figures.

The 1699 did not vanish - 410 of those atoms have real unmet obligations and are tracked by the separate obligationGaps budget below.
